intro.name: Yui
intro.bio: I take K-beauty skincare brands from first quote to a compliant shipment across Europe and Russia/CIS. With a background in food marketing and sensory science, and a brand I founded myself, I care about how products land with real customers.

about.title: About Me
about.paragraph1: I focus on understanding products in depth and communicating their value through market-driven strategies and content. I currently manage the European market at MIRAERO KOREA, focusing on market analysis, product positioning, pricing strategies, and OEM/ODM projects. I also plan and create product presentations and marketing content. Previously, I gained experience in Quality Assurance at PharmaResearch and Regulatory Affairs at Cynosure Lutronic, building a strong foundation in product quality and regulatory compliance. With an academic background in food marketing and sensory science, I developed HUP, a regional food brand, during university. The project won a top award and gave me hands-on experience in product development, branding, and commercial sales. Beyond my professional work, I continue to explore my interest in life sciences by studying biology in English.
